AI Impact on White-Collar Jobs Cited by Goldman Sachs Report

A Goldman Sachs report indicates that Artificial Intelligence is impacting white-collar jobs, particularly in the tech and professional services sectors. The report notes that global tech hiring has frozen since 2022, and call center jobs in the US are 39% below trend. This suggests AI's influence on employment is beginning to be felt in these areas.
